_comment: Milestone 3 design mission. Edit this file to fly a different mission: scripts/m3/run_design_mission.py --mission <file>. Units: m, s, m/s, deg, RPM, kg. Nacelle 90 = helicopter, 0 = airplane.
name: Hot-and-high 1000 km passenger transport
description: 10 passengers (1200 kg) from a 1500 m elevation pad to another 1500 m pad 1000 km away, ISA+15 (the Milestone 1 hover-sizing day), constant headwind aloft, calm at the pads.

engine_ratings._comment: Fraction of the take-off rating available: take-off rating in helicopter mode and conversion (< 5 min), max-continuous (aircraft_input_m2.MCP_FRACTION) in airplane mode.

conversion._comment: Nacelle angle scheduled as a function of airspeed along aircraft_input_m2.CONVERSION_PATH (Milestone 2 corridor), 550 RPM.

cruise._comment: Long-range cruise at the Milestone 1 cruise RPM (250); the cruise length is computed so the total ground distance equals range_km.

reconversion._comment: Deceleration 75 -> 70 m/s with RPM 350 -> 550, then nacelles back along aircraft_input_m2.RECONVERSION_PATH.
